subject: Security tooling procurement: combined Drata + TrustCenter proposal and PS scope
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20 09:14 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor decision for compliance automation + customer portal

Team —

Quick context: Grace Ltd (our target prospect) has asked for an attestation portal and API-level evidence access as part of their security questionnaire. We currently have three viable approaches: go all-in on Vanta for SOC2 automation + their customer portal, use Drata for automation and pair with TrustCenter for a customer-facing portal, or buy TrustCenter and draft internal connectors.

I want to capture a single procurement recommendation and a bounded PS scope (3-5 days) to deliver a working demo for Grace by May 6. Primary constraints are: minimal engineering lift, clear control evidence mapping (SaaS telemetry + infra logs), and a predictable OPEX number for FY28.

Action items I think we need from this thread:
- Stephanie: technical fit + any gaps for Drata vs Vanta on log collection, continuous evidence, and API access (ETA 4/21)
- Rishi: integration complexity estimate (SSO, SCIM, log shipping) and rough infra hours (ETA 4/21)
- Lauren: any legal/contract must-haves for PS + portal onboarding (data sharing, subprocessor disclosure) (ETA 4/22)

I asked both vendors for a short PS SOW (attached) and clarified pricing for a customer-portal add-on. Attaching the draft matrix I compiled.

Thanks —
Monica
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-compliance-matrix-2027.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor decision for compliance automation + customer portal

Thanks Monica — quick notes from my side after a technical pass on docs and the vendor demos: 

- Drata: Strong continuous evidence collection for cloud infra (GCP). Native connectors for GCS, BigQuery, GKE, and a straightforward log forwarding approach for our custom inference telemetry. They expose an evidence API which we can use to push derived artifacts. Their proposed PS covers control mapping and initial evidence pipelines (attached). Risk: their portal is more internal-facing; TrustCenter would be needed for the customer-facing experience.

- Vanta: E2E portal + automation experience is very polished. Their customer portal supports read-only evidence sharing and per-account access. However, collecting some of our custom inference metrics requires building a middleware shim — more eng hours. Pricing for the portal add-on is also higher.

- TrustCenter: clean external portal for per-customer views, document sharing, and Docusign link embedding. Works well as a complement to Drata if we want to keep automation costs lower and buy the portal separately.

Technical ask: if we proceed with Drata + TrustCenter, we should scope the PS to include: evidence API mapping, one canonical log forwarder for inference logs, and a customer-portal integration (OAuth/SCIM). I estimate 30–45 engineering hours plus 2 days of vendor PS coordination.

Stephanie
Security Engineering Manager

Attachments: Drata-SOW-proposed-ps.docx
From: Tyler Murray <tyler@drata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21 09:26 -0700
Subject: Drata SOW + proposal for Redwood (follow-up)

Hi Monica —

Appreciate the conversation yesterday. Attaching the PS SOW our team drafted; it covers control mapping, evidence pipeline implementation for GCP services, and a one-day enablement workshop with your security team. We can commit 12 hours of engineering consultancy under the SOW to build the first evidence pipelines, and we recommend the TrustCenter connector as a low-risk approach to surface evidence to customers.

Quick commercial notes:
- 12 months of Drata automation: $36k (annual) for our platform tier that includes API access.
- PS SOW (fixed): $9,500 (estimated 3 days of our engineers + project manager).
- TrustCenter connector: we can introduce you, but TrustCenter billing is independent.

If you need an extended trial or a POC environment for Grace, we can provision a 30-day sandbox and prioritize the evidence API endpoints.

Best,
Tyler Murray
Enterprise Sales, Drata

Attachments: Drata-SOW-proposed-ps.docx
From: Sarah Cho <sarah@trustcenter.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Tyler Murray <tyler@drata.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21 14:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Drata SOW + proposal for Redwood (TrustCenter notes)

Hi all —

Thanks for including TrustCenter. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- We can provide a branded customer portal instance that supports per-customer document views, embedded attestations, and time-limited API tokens.
- Standard connector work (Auth + evidence fetch) is usually a 2–4 day engagement for us; for Redwood we can offer a fixed-fee connector build ($6,000) if Drata provides the evidence API spec.
- We have a lightweight privacy addendum and subprocessor list we attach for procurement.

If you want, we can run a joint technical call (TrustCenter + Drata + Redwood infra/security) next week to confirm the API handoff and map the demo scope for Grace.

Regards,
Sarah Cho
TrustCenter, Head of Partnerships

Attachments: TrustCenter-portal-demo-notes.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tyler Murray <tyler@drata.com>, Sarah Cho <sarah@trustcenter.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22 16:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Drata SOW + proposal for Redwood (procurement decision request)

Thanks Tyler and Sarah — helpful info.

Internal decision: given budget targets for the demo and minimal engineering lift, the procurement recommendation is to proceed with Drata (12-month automation + PS SOW) and commission TrustCenter to build the portal connector. Total first-year commitment estimate: Drata $36k + Drata PS $9.5k + TrustCenter connector $6k = ~$51.5k. That stays under the demo budget and keeps FY28 OPEX predictable.

Lauren: please confirm any required contract clauses for combining these vendors (data sharing, liability carve-outs, and subprocessor disclosures). If legal signs off, I'll issue the PO to Drata and TrustCenter and request a 30-day sandbox for the Grace demo.

Stephanie / Rishi: please confirm final engineering hours (ETA EOD 4/23) so I can include the internal delivery cost in the PO request.

Tyler / Sarah: please confirm the timeline for the PS kickoff and ability to provision a sandbox (ideally next week).

Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
